Job Title
 CoE SAP BI Business Analyst
 Responsibilities And Main Duties
 SAP BW/4HANA and Data Warehouse applications expert, ensuring the AMS service (Application Management Services) for the company reporting systems: incident and request management, problem analysis, maintenance and evolution.
Monitor daily data loads and process chains, ensuring data quality and system stability.
Support the definition and the implementation of the business intelligence strategy of the company.
Participate in coordination of cross-functional decisions with other areas.
Actively participate in roll-outs and other implementation projects: support fit-gap preparation and execution.
Design of new functionalities, test, training, post go-live support.
Provide user support and training on SAP Analysis for Office (Excel plug-in), leveraging BW/4HANA data models to enable effective reporting and self-service analytics.
 Knowledge
 At least 3 years of hands-on experience with SAP BW/4HANA (mandatory), preferably including AMS / production support activities.
Strong knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA modeling objects (ADSO, CompositeProvider, transformations, DTPs, process chains and BW queries).
Knowledge of data extraction from S/4HANA, including ODP, CDS Views, 2LIS Logistics extractors (LO Cockpit), and ABAP-based DataSource enhancements using CMOD user exits.
Good knowledge of ABAP programming language and ability to use it within SAP BW/4HANA for data transformations, routines, enhancements, and troubleshooting activities.
General knowledge of tools related to Business Intelligence: data models, ETL and data management.
Advanced knowledge of BI-specific monitoring and control tools.
Nice to have: knowledge of SAP BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BO (CMC Scheduler and Broadcaster) and Qlik Sense.
 Additional Skills
 Analytical and problem-solving attitude, with a service-oriented mindset.
Research and self-study attitude.
Forward-thinking and strategic planning.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
 Position IT Organisation
 Reports to the IT HQ BI Delivery Manager.
